entities.summary: Tomas Haake (b. 1971-07-13, Örnsköldsvik) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Örnsköldsvik and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
